content.short: GateRepo helps NFT developers limit access to private GitHub repositories using token gating.
content.description: GateRepo serves as a development tool for NFT projects, enabling NFT developers to restrict access to private GitHub repositories through a token gating mechanism. In practice, access is granted exclusively to wallets that hold a specified type and a specified amount of ERC-20 tokens. This arrangement supports pre-launch activities by providing targeted access for marketing initiatives and for addressing bug fixes before the official launch. This setup emphasizes selective visibility during the critical pre-launch phase.
